title: Orchard Dash
core_loop: The player runs a fox through a small isometric orchard, catching apples as they fall from shaken trees before they hit the ground, while dodging wasps that knock the fox's basket over on contact.
win_condition: Fill the basket to its target count before the orchard's day-timer runs out.
lose_condition: The basket is knocked over by a wasp three times in one run.

adopt: warm light / cool shadow hue shifting, same rule as this repo's own art_direction
high-key value distribution, most of the frame in the upper mids
rounded, chunky low-poly silhouettes over hard geometric ones
reject: screen-shake heavy arcade juice that would fight the cozy tone
art_influences.target: A sunlit orchard rendered in the same warm, pixel-constrained Ghibli-through-16-bit sensibility this repo already established for the cafe, applied outdoors: dappled leaf-shadow, warm cream light, verdant canopy greens, without inventing a new palette philosophy.
